subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 07, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - November 7, 2026**

**Breaking News: Seven Stable Kernels Released with Fixes for Three Xen Vulnerabilities**

In a significant development, Greg Kroah-Hartman has announced the release of seven stable kernels that address three critical Xen vulnerabilities. These kernels, versions 7.3.2 and 6.18.61, are now available for download and installation. This update is a crucial step in ensuring the security and stability of your AcreetionOS system.

**Community News**

* Videos from the 2026 X.Org Developers Conference (XDC) are now available on YouTube. Catch up on the latest developments in the world of open-source graphics and display drivers.
* The AcreetionOS community is thriving, with many active contributors and users sharing their experiences and knowledge. Join the conversation on our Discord server to connect with fellow users and developers.

**Practical Tip:**

* Did you know that you can easily update your AcreetionOS system to the latest kernel version using our automated update process? Simply run the command `sudo pacman -Syu` in your terminal, and our package manager will take care of the rest. This ensures you have the latest security patches and features without manual intervention.

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in the AcreetionOS community by following us on social media and checking our website regularly. Happy hacking!
